usedFor: Mailparser turns emails into structured data, and Google Sheets receives it through “Update Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Update Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Parsed email fields can overwrite rows in a sheet, keeping existing records current.

watchOut: “Update Multiple Rows” changes existing values, so confirm the rows it targets before it runs on every parsed email.
